notes: «- رضيع عائشة -» is a dashed editor gloss on Abd Allah b. Yazid, left out.
«قال فحدثت به شعيب بن الحبحاب» — the teller of Shu'ayb is not named before this point, so the second group starts at Shu'ayb; the Prophet is the end, not a link.
Shu'ayb's Anas is the last link of the second isnad, which carries the same saying.
